A low bed with a simple upholstered headboard in natural linen sits at left, dressed in all-ivory and white cotton bedding. A rough-hewn dark walnut wooden bench sits at the foot of the bed as a rustic accent. In the window bay, a seating vignette consists of two low cream linen armchairs flanking a small round glass-top side table holding a single bud vase with greenery. A low dark walnut side table beside the bed holds a small sculptural figure. A flat-screen television is recessed flush into the right wall. Diffuse natural light fills the entire room in a warm, even ambient wash from the gable window.
